effects.platform: Source-declared local CLI with focused synthetic GNU/Linux-host tests; no native macOS/Windows or final five-target matrix proof.
effects.before: No 1.1.0-only local prepare-local command that persisted a content-addressed smoke report and emitted the same bytes on stdout.
effects.after: The local command validates five exact bundle inputs, stages a native probe when available, writes a digest-addressed e1 smoke report and emits identical JSON bytes. Explicit per-target skip requires a bounded reason, cannot mint Passed or apply-ready status, and does not contact GitHub. The second commit adds only a cfg(test) fake all-assets-ready dispatch proof.

user_impact.reason: Additive local release-operator CLI for mutable 1.1.0 preparation; it changes no existing 1.0.x user-owned inputs and performs no public publication.

documentation_impact.reason: Release/operator guidance must explain prepare-local defaults and options, exact report/stdout bytes, explicit skip semantics, and lack of live publication; final owned page/topic map remains pending.
